**Thesis.** Q3 confirmed demand and improved deal terms (ACV above $25M per MW, payback 1y7m, prepayments above 100% of associated capex, $12B of new contract value, Databricks, Datadog and Snowflake signed), but a third of revenue ($325.1M) was one-off asset-light partnership revenue, receivables jumped to $4.04B (75% one customer), third-party capacity slipped into H1 2027, and 2027 capex of $40-45B came in about $14B above Street models. The stock fell 47% in seven sessions with the whole neocloud group, to $81.31. On end-2029 values of $0 / $93.84 / $416.59 at 35/50/15 the weighted value is $109.41, 10.4% a year: Watch. The base is 6.0x 2030 EBITDA but about 67x EBIT, because five-year GPU depreciation consumes most of the EBITDA of a fleet still growing fast, so the equity is a levered claim on 2028-2030 GPU pricing, on capex per MW, and on funding $6-11B a year outside prepayments. Own at about $72.

**Variant view.** No variant view on price: at $81.31 the weighted value is 10.4% a year, and we share the market's fear of the bear at 35% weight. Our disagreement is with the Street, whose $231.60 mean target is 2.1x our value. On our build, base 2030 EBIT is about $1.8B on $124B of EV (about 67x) and pre-tax income is still negative, because five-year GPU depreciation consumes most of the EBITDA of a fleet bought at about $40M per MW; owner earnings do not support Street-style EBITDA multiples until the build slows. Checkable: Q4 2026 revenue excluding strategic-partnership revenue below $900M (0.55), which would show Q3's beat was the one-off and the Q4 guide leans on more of it.

**Catalysts.**

- Q4 2026 results and full FY2027 guidance (revenue, pre-tax earnings, capacity) (About February 11, 2027 (last year February 12, 2026))
- Remaining New Jersey (Microsoft) tranches and colocation sites moved to H1 2027; first owned-site capacity (Missouri, Lappeenranta, Mäntsälä 2, Alabama) (H1 2027)
- Term-out or repayment of the $3.5B 364-day Citi facility (SOFR + 2.75% rising to 3.50%) (Before about October 21, 2027)
- Further strategic-partnership (asset-light) revenue and VIE advances (up to $662.2M more intended) (Quarterly)
- ClickHouse or Toloka liquidity event (Open)

**Pre-mortem** (written at decision time).

- GPU rental pricing resets in 2028 as Nvidia supply catches up and Rubin reprices Blackwell; renewals of 2025-2026 capacity come in near $10M per MW, and the EBITDA on a $90B+ fleet cannot service the debt. — watch: Disclosed ACV per MW below $20M on new deals; renewal pricing commentary; spot and auction prices below reserve
- Delivery keeps slipping: third-party sites and power hookups run late again, 2027 revenue lands near $9-10B while capex and lease costs are committed, and the gap is filled with equity at low prices. — watch: FY2027 outlook cut below $11B; New Jersey not complete by 2Q27; quarterly AI cloud costs growing faster than recurring revenue
- Funding closes: the Citi bridge is refinanced at punitive spreads or not at all, prepayments fall short of $17-20B, and Nebius sells equity below $50 to keep building. — watch: Prepayments in 2027 below $15B; equity issuance below $50; secured debt above SOFR + 5%; covenant waivers
- The Q3 beat was the high-water mark: asset-light partnership revenue does not recur, and the recurring AI cloud margin turns out to be near 30%, not 50%, because lease and site costs for idle capacity run ahead of billing. — watch: Q4 revenue excluding partnerships below $900M; adjusted EBITDA margin below 35% in any 2027 quarter
- A concentrated customer base (Microsoft, Meta, venture-funded labs) delays or cuts commitments as AI funding tightens after the November selloff. — watch: RPO falling quarter on quarter; disclosed contract reductions or terminations; receivables rising faster than revenue
- The Watch call is wrong on the upside: the selloff was indiscriminate, Nebius delivers the 2027 build on its owned sites at today's pricing, prepayments fund the capex as guided, and the stock re-rates toward the Street's $200+ while we wait for $80. — watch: Q4 revenue excluding partnerships above $1.0B; RPO above $50B; Citi facility termed out at or below SOFR + 3%

**Kill criteria.**

- FY2027 revenue outlook cut below $11B at or before the Q1 2027 report (initial outlook $12-13B; bear 2027 $9.0B) (check by 2027-06-15) — open
- Shares outstanding plus pre-funded warrant shares above 370M at any quarter-end through Q3 2027 (313.97M at September 30, 2026) (check by 2027-11-30) — open
- RPO falls quarter on quarter, or a customer termination or reduction affecting more than $1B of contract value is disclosed, through Q3 2027 (check by 2027-11-30) — open
- Equity sold below $50 a share, or new secured debt priced above SOFR + 5%, before December 31, 2027 (check by 2028-01-31) — open
- Group adjusted EBITDA margin below 30% in any 2027 quarter, or below 35% in two consecutive 2027 quarters (FY2026 guide about 40%; base 2027 38%, bear 30%) (check by 2028-03-31) — open

**What would change the view.**

- Toward Own: a price at or below about $72 at these weights (15% a year)
- Toward Own: Q4 revenue excluding partnerships at or above $1.0B and RPO at or above $50B, which would justify a 20% bull (30/50/20 gives $130.24, 17.0% a year)
- Toward Own: evidence that all-in capex per MW added is nearer $35M than $40M (fair value $131.01, 17.2%), for example a disclosed cost per MW on owned sites
- Toward Avoid: a FY2027 revenue outlook below $11B, equity sold below $50, RPO falling quarter on quarter, or adjusted EBITDA margin below 30% in a 2027 quarter

**Independent review: grade B** (evidence 4, valuation 3, variant view 3, risk 4, calibration 3). Counter-case: The case for Own: the model is conservative where it counts. Management's own figures (ACV above $25M per MW, 1 year 7 months payback on a revenue basis covering opex and capex) imply capex of roughly $20-22M per MW on Q3 deals, against the $40M the model charges; at $35M the value clears the Own line. With prepayments now covering more than 100% of the associated capex, the 35% bear that wipes out the equity is a credit scenario the funding mix is designed to avoid. On that reading $81.31 is a mispricing, and Watch-and-wait is a distinction without a difference.

**Response.** Accepted from round 2: the rest of the 2030 capacity is now charged by end-2029 and the convertibles carry their cash coupons (about $263M a year) with the case rate only on the rest of net debt; together they lower the fair value to $109.41 (10.4% a year), and Own now needs about $72. The margin kill criterion moved to below 30% in any 2027 quarter or below 35% in two consecutive quarters; the $40M per MW is derived from the $40-45B 2027 guide for more than 1 GW, with $35M ($131.01, 17.2%) and $45M ($87.73, 2.6%) printed; every sensitivity is now printed by the script; the stale projection and inputs text is fixed; the deferred-revenue path is labelled an assumption; the bull's 15% is tied to Q3 deal terms with a 20% trigger. On the counter-case we keep Watch: the payback figure covers GPUs and fit-out on one quarter's deals, not the owned-site shells, power and pre-build the 2027 guide pays for, and prepayments above 100% apply to Q3's new deals, not to the $6-11B a year of 2027 capex Nebius says falls outside prepayments and investment-grade financing, which is what a 364-day bridge and a tighter credit market put at risk. The bias moves to neutral; capex evidence near $35M per MW, a price near $72, or Q4 recurring revenue of $1.0B with RPO of $50B would move the call to Own.

**Data notes.** The October call was a backfill whose values were FY2031 EV/EBITDA values; this update states end-2029 values, undiscounted, on 2030 adjusted EBITDA, as the November IREN update does. Discounted at the initiation's 12.28% for three years, $109.41 at end-2029 is about $77 today, 52% below October's discounted $161.95. The value fell a little further than the price. Net debt starts at September 30 debt principal of $16,478.0M (convertible notes at their accreted maturity amounts plus the $751.8M MUFG term loan) less $7,425.6M of unrestricted cash; $1,215.5M of restricted cash is excluded. Q4 2026 adds about $11.6B of capex (FY2026 about $27B less $15.43B in nine months), $0.9B of VIE note advances and a quarter's interest (convertible cash coupons of about $263M a year, plus the case rate on the rest of net debt; the notes' accretion is already in the $16,478.0M), less Q4 adjusted EBITDA of about $374M (36% on about $1.04B of Q4 revenue). The $3.5B Citi facility and lease liabilities are not added: drawn proceeds fund capex already counted, and site leases sit inside cost of revenue and EBITDA. Capex is MW added times $40M (bear $42M) all-in, half paid in the year before the MW bills, and the rest of the 2030 additions is charged by end-2029 (base $10B, bull $16B), so the forward EBITDA is fully paid for. The $40M follows from the guide: $40-45B of 2027 capex 'sized for more than 1 GW', including owned-site shells, power and pre-build. The letter's payback of 1y7m 'on a revenue basis' at ACV above $25M per MW implies roughly $20-22M of GPU and fit-out capex per MW on Q3 deals, excluding the shell; at $35M per MW the fair value is $131.01 (17.2%), at $45M $87.73 (2.6%). The base's 2027 capex of $31B is below the guide because it adds 0.75 GW, not more than 1 GW. Receivables were $4,039.9M at September 30 (from $720.3M at December 31), 75% from one customer (Customer D); Q3 operating cash flow was -$273.0M although deferred revenue rose $3.43B, which suggests invoiced prepayments not yet collected. The model collects them and holds receivables at 45 days of revenue by end-2029. The adjustment is applied at end-2029, outside the interest roll-forward; collecting earlier would add less than $1 a share. Deferred revenue ($9.41B at September 30) rises in a straight line to $14B / $24B / $32B at end-2029 and counts as a cash inflow; 75% of the end-2029 balance is deducted from equity value because Nebius treats the prepayments as carrying a significant financing component and accretes interest on them ($121.1M in nine months 2026). Deducting 50% or 100% moves the fair value to $119.20 or $99.60. The end-2029 balances are assumptions, not derived from the $17-20B of 2027 prepayments guided less a recognition schedule, which Nebius does not give. A convertible series converts when the case's end-2029 value is above its conversion price times its accretion ratio: June 2025 notes $51.45 (about $178.7M original, accreting to $214.4M), September 2025 notes $138.75 (115%, break-even about $159.56), March 2026 notes $183.22 and $180.31 (120%), August 2026 notes $313.46 (110%) and $324.65 (125%). Shares start at 319.46M (292.90M outstanding, 21.07M NVIDIA pre-funded warrants, 5.49M unvested RSUs) and grow 1.5% a year from stock compensation ($196.5M in nine months 2026). Cross-check on depreciation (five-year GPU life on 65% of gross PP&E, 20 years on the rest): base 2030 D&A about $18.8B, EBIT about $1.8B (EV/EBIT about 67x at 6.0x EBITDA), pre-tax about -$2.3B. Exit EV per average MW billing in 2030 is about $43.5M in the base, roughly replacement cost. The bull's EV/EBIT is about 22x; the bear's EBIT is negative. Management's Q4 2027 pre-tax breakeven needs better pricing, lower capex per MW or slower growth than the base. Sensitivities at 35/50/15 (all printed by the script): base exit 5.5x $97.29 (6.2% a year), 7.0x $133.64 (18.0%); every case at 10% on non-convertible debt $105.75 (9.2%); capex $35M per MW $131.01 (17.2%), $45M $87.73 (2.6%); base revenue per MW -$1M $97.08, -$2M $84.67; base 2030 margin 46% gives a base of $70.58; $15B of base equity at $50 gives a base of $75.03; weights 30/50/20 $130.24 (17.0%), 40/45/15 $104.72, 40/50/10 $88.58 (2.9%). The base exit multiple that returns $81.31 is about 5.7x. The bull carries $62.49 of the $109.41; without it (bear and base reweighted) the value is $55.20. Own needs a price at or below about $71.94. The weights: the bull keeps 15%, not 10%, because Q3 deal terms (ACV above $25M per MW, prepayments above 100% of capex) are bull-case terms today; it rises to 20% only if Q4 shows recurring revenue at or above $1.0B and RPO at or above $50B. Recurring Q3 margin: if the $325.1M of partnership revenue carried no cost, AI cloud adjusted EBITDA on the other $648.7M of AI cloud revenue was $193.1M (29.8%); if it carried half its revenue in cost, 54.8%. The 6-K does not disclose its cost. Starting capacity (300 / 350 / 380 MW billing at end-2026) and revenue per MW are fitted to the FY2026 guide and the $12-13B FY2027 outlook; Nebius discloses no active-MW figure in the text of the letter, and its capacity charts (images) were not read. Base rates: all three revenue paths (77%, 127%, 156% a year from $3.0B) are above the 99th percentile for companies starting at $1.5-3B; Nebius is building a business, not growing one. capital.multiples gives no usable check: 20-F annual facts only, and SIC 7370 peers are software companies. Nebius reports quarters on 6-K, which data/calendar/earnings.csv (8-K Item 2.02) does not record, so library/CALENDAR.md did not flag this update as due. Review round 1 (agent:reviewing-research, grade C): the first draft rated Own at $150.20 (22.7% a year). It charged no capex for 2030 additions that the forward EBITDA counted, treated $4.04B of receivables and $1.22B of restricted cash as cash, charged 6.0-7.5% on opening balances, had no stock-comp dilution, ignored accretion in the conversion test, deducted 50% of prepayments without reason, set claims that contradicted the weights, and never tested the 6.0x exit against cash returns. Fixed: capex at $40-42M per MW with half a year's lead, unrestricted cash, receivables to 45 days, average balances at 7.0-9.0%, 1.5% a year of dilution, conversion against accreted principal, 75% of prepayments deducted, claims realigned, a margin kill criterion, EV/EBIT and per-MW cross-checks. Fair value $121.82, Watch. Review round 2 (grade B): half of the 2030 capacity was still unpaid at end-2029; the case rate was charged on convertibles already carried at their accreted amounts; the margin kill line (35% in any quarter) sat inside the base path; $40M per MW was unsourced; the 46% margin sensitivity did not reproduce; stale text in the projection and inputs. Fixed: the rest of the 2030 capacity charged by end-2029, convertibles charged their cash coupons, kill line at 30% (or 35% for two quarters), capex per MW derived from the guide with $35M / $45M sensitivities, all sensitivities printed by the script, text corrected. Fair value $109.41 (10.4% a year), bias moved to neutral.
